---
title: "Contact and collaboration"
subtitle: "For researchers, institutions and organisations interested in collaborating with GiniUs"
toc: false
---

We welcome contact from external researchers and organisations, in particular in the **transfer areas** of the project:

::: {.transfer-grid}
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Measuring inequality</b><br>Estimation of the Gini index, bias correction, variances and confidence intervals; income and gender inequality</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Missing data</b><br>Non-response in income surveys; response mechanisms; single and multiple imputation</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Software</b><br>The R package <i>giniVarCI</i>; reproducible research with R and Quarto</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Water</b><br>Inequality in water consumption, availability and prices; water reuse and governance</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Tourism</b><br>Tourism and inequality; tourism and gender; regional development</div>
<div class="transfer-item"><b>Business management</b><br>Missing data in strategic management and international business research</div>
:::

## Send us a message

The form opens your email application with the message ready to send. No data are stored on this website.

```{=html}
<!-- To change the contact address, edit CONTACT_EMAIL below (one line). -->
<form id="contact-form" class="contact-form" onsubmit="return giniusContact(event)">
  <div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="cf-name">Name</label>
      <input class="form-control" id="cf-name" required></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="cf-inst">Institution</label>
      <input class="form-control" id="cf-inst"></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="cf-area">Area of interest</label>
      <select class="form-select" id="cf-area">
        <option>Gini index: bias, variances and confidence intervals</option>
        <option>Missing data and imputation</option>
        <option>R package giniVarCI</option>
        <option>Water</option>
        <option>Tourism</option>
        <option>Business management</option>
        <option>Gender inequality</option>
        <option>Data sharing</option>
        <option>Seminars, visits and research stays</option>
        <option>Other</option>
      </select></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="cf-type">Type of collaboration</label>
      <select class="form-select" id="cf-type">
        <option>Joint research or co-authorship</option>
        <option>Applying the methods to my data</option>
        <option>Seminar or conference invitation</option>
        <option>Research stay</option>
        <option>Information about the project</option>
      </select></div>
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label" for="cf-msg">Message</label>
      <textarea class="form-control" id="cf-msg" rows="5" required></textarea></div>
    <div class="col-12"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Prepare email</button></div>
  </div>
</form>
<script>
const CONTACT_EMAIL = "jfmunoz@ugr.es";
function giniusContact(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const v = id => document.getElementById(id).value.trim();
  const subject = `[GiniUs] Collaboration: ${v("cf-area")}`;
  const body = `Name: ${v("cf-name")}\nInstitution: ${v("cf-inst")}\nArea of interest: ${v("cf-area")}\nType of collaboration: ${v("cf-type")}\n\n${v("cf-msg")}`;
  window.location.href = `mailto:${CONTACT_EMAIL}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
  return false;
}
</script>
```

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" crossorigin="">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" crossorigin=""></script>

<script>
(function () {
  function draw() {
    if (typeof L === "undefined") { setTimeout(draw, 200); return; }
    const p = [37.1938, -3.5985];
    const map = L.map("contact-map", {scrollWheelZoom: false}).setView(p, 16);
    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      maxZoom: 19, attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
    }).addTo(map);
    L.circleMarker(p, {radius: 11, color: "#fff", weight: 2, fillColor: "#C9962B", fillOpacity: 0.95}).addTo(map)
      .bindPopup("<b>Facultad de Ciencias Económicas y Empresariales</b><br>Universidad de Granada<br>Campus de Cartuja, 18071 Granada").openPopup();
  }
  draw();
})();
</script>
```
